Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in

Class KfeWalletNetworkService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.KfeWalletNetworkService
@Service public class KfeWalletNetworkService extends Object
Coordinates wallet-facing network reads and cold-wallet transaction preparation. Receive capability responses combine wallet ownership/status with provider availability, while UTXO listing and PSBT creation enforce active-wallet ownership and use live chain state as input evidence.

    • receivingCapabilities

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public KfeReceivingCapabilitiesResponse receivingCapabilities(Long senderUserId, String receiverIdentifier)
      Resolves receiver rails and eligible sender source wallets for the specified user. Receiver availability is based on active spendable internal wallets, Lightning gateway health, and active on-chain receive addresses; sender sources are filtered against those available rails.
      Parameters:
      senderUserId - optional sender whose active wallets should be included
      receiverIdentifier - username, numeric platform user ID, or wallet UUID
      Returns:
      capability snapshot; unavailable receiver identifiers yield a result with a reason code

    • listUtxos

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<KfeUtxoResponse> listUtxos(Long userId, UUID walletId)
      Lists the deduplicated live UTXO projection for an owned active wallet. Active addresses are queried individually; watch-only descriptors add gap-range coverage when available.
      Parameters:
      userId - authenticated wallet owner
      walletId - wallet whose UTXOs are requested
      Returns:
      projected unspent outputs keyed by transaction outpoint
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the wallet is not owned by the user
      IllegalStateException - if the wallet is not active
      com.kerosene.common.exception.FinancialProviderUnavailableException - if no blockchain client is configured

    • createColdWalletPsbt

      @Transactional public KfeColdWalletPsbtResponse createColdWalletPsbt(Long userId, UUID walletId, KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest request)
      Creates and audits a funded unsigned PSBT for an owned active watch-only wallet. The live UTXO set is authoritative for input ownership; caller-supplied outpoints are only selectors. A nonblank TOTP code is verified before funding, and the returned PSBT is persisted in a workflow.
      Parameters:
      userId - authenticated wallet owner
      walletId - watch-only wallet used for inputs and change
      request - destination, amount, fee options, optional input selectors, and optional TOTP proof
      Returns:
      unsigned PSBT and its durable review workflow identifier
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when wallet ownership, destination, or selected inputs are invalid
      IllegalStateException - when wallet policy or required cold-wallet metadata is invalid
      com.kerosene.common.exception.FinancialProviderUnavailableException - when Bitcoin Core RPC is unavailable
